title: give: the call
description: Gives one part: the message and the envelope the giver signed, each as standard base64 of its exact bytes. The door hands the mediator the bytes as decoded. A give has no wait; with a judge it may take up to 20 seconds.

call.description: What is signed: the call's canonical bytes.

accord.description: The Accord id the caller expects the window to serve.

at.description: The caller's clock; the door refuses a call more than 60 seconds from its own (stale).

message.description: The crossing message: one part in ROLE_USER, under placket's extension, its kind and salt in the part's metadata.

envelope.description: The envelope, {"hash","seq","sig"}, signed by the giver over the message's typed hash and its next seq.
